question: Should OpenClaw accept currentTokenCount plus computeContextEngineMessageBudget and estimateTranscriptTokenPressure as stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contracts now, or fold token headroom into the broader assemble metadata RFC?
rationale: The PR changes a third-party plugin-facing API and SDK runtime exports, while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82137 is still open for related assemble metadata design.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Repairs
options.body: Approve currentTokenCount as a separate backward-compatible API after the two P2 fixes and real behavior proof are supplied.

options.title: Fold Into The RFC
options.body: Pause or close this PR and land token headroom together with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble metadata design.

options.title: Keep Helpers Private For Now
options.body: Allow the assemble field but remove or defer the public SDK helper exports until the SDK surface is maintainer-owned.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Repairs
recommendation.body: Approve currentTokenCount as a separate backward-compatible API after the two P2 fixes and real behavior proof are supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and have the strongest recent merged history on the context-engine token-budget path.
